requests

# The version supports multiple semantics

boto3==1.26.0     # Exact version
requests>=2.28.0  # Minimum version
urllib3<=2.0.0    # Maximum version
botocore~=1.29.0  # Compatible release (>=1.29.0,<1.30.0)
pyyaml!=5.4.0     # Version exclusion

# Hash Verification
requests==2.28.0 --hash=sha256:7f1b6a0a0aa2f5bc6f6a4b7eaf1a5b5c3b0e1b0e1b0e1b0e1b0e1b0e1b0e1b0e1b0e1b0e1b0e

# Conditional installations based on environment:
# Install only on Windows
pywin32>=300; sys_platform=='win32'
